# Scoped installed-material presence (joint unpublished 0.1.9)

`scoped_presence` separates negotiated InventoryV2 provisionability from one
already-issued grant's private installation. No report or receipt is execution
or placement authority. Legacy modules, schemas and fixtures retain their bytes.
The combined0.1.9 archive is published only after this module and accepted-
preparation v2 independently freeze and pass the package gate.

InventoryV2 contains only explicit `provisionable_only` profile/revisions plus
qualified harness references. Scoped Present/Missing/Unknown reports bind one
node/logical boot/kernel boot, attempt/grant/owner, actual retained installation
and accepted inventory identity. Present includes a fresh digest/size observation
and the exact original nonsecret private installation record, hash-matched to
its retained receipt. Qualification and referenced Definition bodies must be
installed by the actual owner; capability strings or DTO validity do not qualify
an adapter. No path or secret bytes are carried.

The qualified worker must read after acquiring that exact opaque live permit and
check its CLOCK_BOOTTIME observation/send interval. The server anchors maximum
age to the actual immutable grant-revision issuance, never HTTP receive time
alone or an assumed synchronized worker wall clock. Exact replay preserves the
original recorded deadline. New scoped negatives remain dominant after expiry;
no older Present fallback is permitted. Only the daemon owner can enforce these
current-state rules; structural validation cannot authenticate a producer.

Separate packaged schemas/fixtures use `artifacts/scoped-presence-*`; the exporter
is `export_scoped_presence`. `tools/scoped_presence_vectors.py` independently
checks canonical private-record/qualification hashes and monotonic TTL vectors.
Schemas deny unknown mutation fields and publish byte/count bounds, including
`x-utf8-byte-limit`. Relational timing, reference identity, current authorization
and fresh worker I/O require actual validator/owner checks. The real worker
producer and extracted joint package are separate qualification gates.
